symptoms: AGVs were unable to exchange totes.
The site was unable to bag out and the sorter was not communicating.
The system was reported as unable to run despite no AGVs being faulted or crashed.
Communication with XLEs was lost, with failed TCP connectivity tests.
Tasks accumulated, including 80 canceled and 88 received tasks.
incident_description: Production operations at UPS Haslet were seriously impacted when the AGV and sorter system could not exchange totes or bag out. Evidence showed lost XLE communication, failed connectivity tests, and an abnormal task state. A system purge produced interim movement and tote exchange, while later case evidence recorded resolution and closure. The reported resolution explanation attributes the communication blockage to a firewall issue.
customer_operational_impact: Tote exchange and bag-out operations were unavailable or impaired, preventing normal sorting and seriously affecting production.
what_resolved_it: The case records that a firewall issue was identified as blocking XLE communication with the rest of the system. The evidence also records a system purge during recovery and later case resolution/closure, but it does not specify the exact firewall change or provide a complete live-system validation.
follow_up_required: Review and document the firewall condition that blocked communication between XLEs, scanners, the sorter, and the system.
Validate sustained XLE, scanner, sorter, and tote-exchange operation after recovery.
Review residual or separate operational concerns, including reported intermittent AGV/sorter interruption and stunnel errors.

retrieval_text: Case 233681 at UPS Haslet TX (TXRTH), Haslet, Texas, customer UPS. Production was seriously impacted when AGVs and the sorter could not exchange totes or bag out. Evidence documented lost XLE communication, failed TCP connectivity, abnormal task accumulation, and no reported AGV faults or crashes. A system purge produced interim tote movement, and the recorded resolution attributed the communication blockage to a firewall issue affecting XLEs and the rest of the system. The case was resolved on 2026-08-25 and later closed, although the exact resolution time and downtime are unavailable.
